description: This file defines the StringTable class responsible for creating and writing the string table used in XLSX worksheet files within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles string deduplication, XML serialization of string data, and rich text formatting.

classes.name: StringTable
classes.description: Handles creation and serialization of the string table for XLSX worksheets, including deduplication of strings and writing rich text formatting to XML.

methods.name: createStringTable
methods.description: Generates a string table for a worksheet by collecting unique string and rich text cell values, optionally merging with existing tables.

methods.name: writeStringTable
methods.description: Serializes the string table into XML format, using either disk caching or memory based on configuration.

methods.name: writeRichText
methods.description: Writes rich text elements into XML with proper formatting and style attributes.

methods.name: writeRichTextForCharts
methods.description: Writes rich text elements for charts, converting plain text into rich text if necessary.

methods.name: flipStringTable
methods.description: Creates a flipped version of the string table for quick lookup of string indices.
